dedupe_keys.name: climate energy dataset for off grid electricity infrastructure

description: The Center of Intelligent System and Network Research in Pakistan publishes electrical and climate data for an off-grid network in the Kalam region. Zenodo supplies a dataset archive and documentation free under CC BY 4.0. The description reports five-minute measurements from 6 March 2023 to 24 October 2024, spanning four micro-hydro generators, twenty-six transformers and 585 end users. Voltage, current and power-factor observations are combined with ERA5 weather variables, with more than forty-five million stated instances. These series can calibrate microgrid demand, generation and climate-response simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this system. Coverage is one mountainous off-grid network; ERA5 is gridded reanalysis, not local weather instrumentation. A limitation is that the count of instances and channel alignment remain provider claims. No archive or supplementary PDF was downloaded, and no meter quality or power balance was checked.
name: Climate Energy Dataset For Off Grid Electricity Infrastructure
